editorial.blurb: Chef Kanemaru's intimate eight-seat omakase bar delivers Tokyo-caliber sushi with meticulous technique and genuine hospitality in a serene, distraction-free setting.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive a few minutes early for your reservation to settle in—the chef's multi-course progression unfolds at a thoughtful pace, and staff will personalize explanations if you ask questions about the fish selection.

topDishes.note: Among the best ever tasted in the United States
